notes.title: Roadmap Update || Our plans for DLCs, features and more! 🚀
notes.content:
Hello fellow Commanders! ⚔️

Autumn is on the horizon... 🍂 It's time for a [b]Game Roadmap Update[/b]! 🎇

We have a lot planned, we hope you're excited as us. 🤩

[h2]🛣️ Game Roadmap - Our plans until mid-2026[/h2]

🔽 More details below 🔽

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/f3d7e5fdf1cb7eb679caa5227683f733891d5ca2.png[/img]

[list]

[*]🧑‍🏫 [b]Faction Tutorials[/b] for all existing factions
[*]🤝 [b]Friend Pass[/b] to invite your friends in skirmish (PC-only)
[*]👀 [b]Spectator Mode[/b] for skirmish
[*][i]And more to come ...[/i]
[/list]

[list]
[*]📖 [b]New Campaign[/b] standalone from the main campaign
[*]🪖 [b]New Playable Faction[/b] with new units
[*]🫅 [b]New Hero Classes[/b] for new skirmish strategies
[*]🃏 [b]New Cards[/b] for the strategy map and battles
[/list]
[i][b]Location Management Upgrade[/b] - Coming Q1/2 2026[/i]
[list]
[*]🏰 [b]Progression Tree[/b] for locations with deeper customization
[*]⚖️ [b]Full Rebalancing Pass[/b] for campaign and skirmish
[*]🧪 [b]Planned Open Beta[/b] before release for polishing
[/list]
[i][b]DLC 3[/b] - Coming Q2/3 2026[/i]
[list]
[*]📖 [b]New Campaign[/b] standalone from the main campaign
[*]🪖 [b]New Playable Faction[/b] with new units
[*]🫅 [b]New Hero Classes[/b] for new skirmish strategies
[*]🃏 [b]New Cards[/b] for the strategy map and battles
[*][i]And more to come ...[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

Your [b]reviews are key[/b] to supporting us. 💪

If you enjoy [i]Songs of Silence[/i], please take a minute ([i]tops, I promise![/i]) to leave us a [b]Steam review[/b].

We'd love to see ratings cross 80%, ensuring better exposure - and more people in-game! 🤗

See you on the battlefield! ⚔️

Cheers,
The Chimera team

notes.title: HERO QUESTS OVERHAUL | Update 1.4.5 🛠️

[i]Bug Fixing[/i]

notes.title: Update 1.3 ⚔️ OUT NOW | New Scenario, Skirmish Difficulties, and more!
notes.content:
⚔️ Greetings Commanders! ⚔️

We've just released Songs of Silence's [b]Update 1.3[/b]! 🥳

It is PACKED with content and improvements. ✨ 

Details below! 👇

[h2]✨ Update 1.3 Overview[/h2]

[i]Game Content[/i]
[list]
[*]👑 [b]NEW SCENARIO[/b] - Uncover Garin's origin story 👹
[*]⚔️ [b]SKIRMISH DIFFICULTY FATES[/b] - It's here! Fine-tune the AI to be easier or ruthless...
[*]💫 [b]ADDITIONAL FATES (3)[/b] - Ruins, monster lairs... More Skirmish customization!
[/list]
[i]UI/UX & Quality of Life[/i]
[list]
[*]🔎 [b]NEW POWER TOOLTIPS[/b] - Effects that modify units' power are now listed in tooltips!
[*]🏰 [b]Location Prosperity UI[/b] - Now visible at all times for Crusade players
[*]🕯️ [b]Scenario UI[/b] - Visual highlight when a new scenario is available
[*]🔠 [b]High-readability Font[/b] - Improved the material
[/list]
[i]Balancing[/i]
[list]
[*]😈 [b]Crusade Balancing[/b] - General improvements
[*]⚖️ [b]Campaign Balancing[/b] - Addressed chapter 4 & 6 difficulty spikes
[/list]
[h3]👑 [b]New Scenario - Song of Cinder[/b][/h3]

Uncover [b]Garin's origin story[/b], in a tale where power clashes with faith... 💥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/c1f890ee4c23d9a5738278fd3f3503557c4fba76.png[/img]
[i]Sent to the distant corners of Irdheim, a Kantor and his unobtrusive apprentice arrived at the prosperous gates of Andrik. Yet, the Crusade, ever eager to spread its faith and steadily growing in power, finds no welcome in these lands.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]
[h3]⚔️ [b]Skirmish - Difficulty Fates[/b][/h3]

We've added [b]2 Skirmish Difficulty Fates[/b] - available for all immediately! 😎

👉 Head to the in-game [i]Encyclopedia[/i] to claim them! 📖

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/5cd141b623599f93fe5ffc5a5b155a838664892c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]
[h3]⚔️ [b]New Tooltips - Display of Effects on Power[/b][/h3]

This is [u]BIG[/u] 🤩 You can now visualize through tooltips ...
[list]
[*] [b]The modified Attack & Defense Power[/b] of units in the army inspect screen! 🛡️ 🤺
[*] [b]The list off all effects[/b] affecting these power values! 📃 👀
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/649652b0ff8c66652ff6f35a930448210a9975fc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]
[h3]⚖️ [b]Balancing - Update 1.3 Changes[/b][/h3]

[i]Crusade[/i]
[list]
[*] Removed Minor Summoning recruitment card
[*] Recruitment | Added Voidmare to Purgatory (50/40/30 Void Essence) as starting card
[*] Recruitment | Added Maelgot to Purgatory (60/50/40 Void Essence)
[*] Recruitment | Added Hesher to Purgatory (Costs: 65/55/45 Void Essence)
[*] Strategy | Move Purgatory cost reduced [strike]25[/strike] -> 20
[*] Strategy | Unsing income changed : Prosperity [strike]3/6/9[/strike] -> 2/4/6
[*] Building | Void Effigy cost changed : [strike]40BM / 30 VE[/strike] -> 20BM / 100G
[*] Building | Void Effigy income added : 3/5/7 Void Essence
[*] Building | Black Temple cost changed : [strike]20BM / 50G[/strike] -> 40BM / 30G
[*] Building | Void Beacon cost changed : [strike]20BM / 40G[/strike] -> 30BM / 50G
[*] Building | Void Beacon income increased : 4/6/8 VE + 1/2/3 Prosperity
[*] Hero | Vessel (all) starting army : size +1
[*] Hero | Vessel - Voidborn starting card : [strike]Lesser Void Summoning[/strike] -> Void Effigy Lv. 2
[*] Hero | Arbiter - Void Summoner starting army : [strike]Maelgot[/strike] -> Ringbound
[*] Hero | Arbiter - Garin stats : [strike]Power 8 + Dread 2[/strike] -> Power 5 + Dread 1
[*] Hero | Arbiter - Garin Void Implosion battle card : Power [strike]4/6/8[/strike] -> 3/4/5
[*] Battle | Unleash Voidkin cooldown : [strike]30s[/strike] -> 20s cooldown
[*] Artifact | Vow of Pride bonus : x2 for fortified locations removed
[/list]
[i]Campaign[/i]
[list]
[*] Map 04 | Added guidance for Forlorn side-quest through cutscenes + speech bubbles
[*] Map 04 | Added guidance on Enclave upgrade
[*] Map 04 | Added guidance on defending against Kantor in the South
[*] Map 08 | Light-side - Unveiled Fog of War at start of turn 1
[*] Map 08 | Light-side - Added guidance through speech bubbles + camera pan
[*] Map 08 | Dark-side - Unveiled Fog of War at start of turn 1
[*] Map 08 | Dark-side - Added guidance through speech bubbles
[*] Map 08 | Dark-side - Added guidance with Eila marker adjustment
[/list]
[h3]🐞 [b]Known Issues[/b][/h3]

We'll be improving a few things we know are a bit [i]clunky[/i] very soon...
[list]
[*] Power tooltip does not update automatically if army composition changed
[*] Banding perk not applying between certain units
[*] Gatebreakers's Keg not working as intended
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

And that's all for today folks! 🫡

As usual - have fun, and do leave us a review if you like the game! ✨

⚔️ See you on the battlefield! ⚔️

Cheers,
The Chimera Team

Hello fellow Commanders! ⚔️

[h2]🎮 Scenario & Skirmish Difficulties - Open BETA 🎮[/h2]

[b]Update 1.3[/b] is less than 2 weeks away! 🤩

It will bring our [b]3rd Scenario[/b] + [b]Skirmish Difficulty Fates[/b]. 😎

Help us polish both! ✨ [b]Play & Send us your feedback[/b] ... 📝

👉 In Steam go to Library > Songs of Silence > Settings > Properties > Betas
👉 Select open_beta branch > Play!

👉 To send your feedback : head over to our dedicated [url=https://forms.gle/RS7L6wWu4hWdoCPk6][b]Feedback Form[/b][/url] 📝

⚠️ [b]WARNING[/b] ⚠️ [b]DO NOT REVERT to the Default branch[/b] before Update 1.3 is released!! ⚠️

[*] [i]You risk breaking your saves and game progression...[/i]
[/list]

Cheers,

notes.title: Update 1.2 ⚔️ OUT NOW!
notes.content:
⚔️ Greetings Commanders! ⚔️

We've just released Songs of Silence's [b]Update 1.2[/b]! 🥳

As well as the [b]second map[/b] of our latest game mode - ✨ [i]Scenarios[/i] ✨

Details below! 👇

[h2]✨ Update 1.2 Overview[/h2]

[i]Game Content[/i]
[list]
[*]👑 [b]NEW SCENARIO[/b] - Fend off endless waves of Lighteaters!
[*]🏆 [b]NEW ACHIEVEMENTS[/b] - 3 new additions for Scenarios
[/list]
[i]Balancing & Quality of Life[/i]
[list]
[*]🎨 [b]Choose your color[/b] in Skirmish (finally!)
[*]🔠 [b]Player warning[/b] when replacing building upgrades
[*]💰 [b]General economy[/b] and balancing improvements
[*]🕯️ [b]Visual cues added to chapter 4[/b] to help locate refugees
[/list]
[i]Bugs Fixed[/i]
[list]
[*]🏰 AI focuses more on capital locations
[*]🪖 AI doesn't get stuck when attacking a sieging army
[*] ... [i]and many smaller ones![/i]
[/list]
[h3]👑 [b]New Scenario - The Ballad of Fourfang[/b][/h3]

Soldiers, stand your ground! Fend off incoming waves of Lighteaters, and try to clear all challenges...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/62913f468a844ae4d7560fc36050b713794cb7da.png[/img]
[i]In a far corner of the world, an empire falls, beyond hope of salvation. As more land is consumed by Silence and the expanding empire of the Lighteaters, one man remains, bound to repay his debt.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/0ccac3442431f42c65cb5d6db687371c40192932.png[/img]
[h3]🎨 [b]Skirmish - Player Color Selection[/b][/h3]

[i]Choose your faction color in single- & multiplayer Skirmish![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/cdb7038b776e10647d1d7d228327ad6ab5b861e9.png[/img]
[h3]⚖️ [b]Balancing - Update 1.2 Changes[/b][/h3]

[i]General[/i]
[list]
[*] Wyldwoods, Capitals, Mine, Excavation Sites | Reduced build-up + upgrade costs (20-50%)
[*] Mine | Increased Lvl 3 income (30 -> 32 BM)
[*] Primordial Shrine | Summon Primordial taken out for cleaner priest definition
[/list]
[i]Thousand Kingdoms[/i]
[list]
[*] Tithe Card | New skill with 0 cost, reduces Prosperity growth in exchange for Gold loot wagon
[*] Silent Knights | Added to Fortress & Bastion (Lvl 2) + Cost reduced (175 -> 160 G)
[*] Divine Host | Added to Temple, City, Capital (Lvl 3) + Cost reduced (85-75-65 G -> 75-65-55 G)
[*] Divine Favor Trade Card | Added to Capital, Enclave, Starborn City (100 G for 25 DF)
[/list]
[i]Old Race[/i]
[list]
[*] Populate Card | New card adding 1 Firstborn Civilian for free per turn
[*] Light Link | Cost reduced to 0
[*] Summon War Titan | Cost structure changed (75 BM + 120 H -> 120 BM + 75 H)
[*] Summon Transport Konstrukt | Cost structure changed (15 BM + 60 H -> 60 BM + 15 H)
[*] Recruit Civilian | Cost reduced (60 -> 40 G)
[*] Warrior | Cost reduced (70 -> 50 G)
[*] Prideful | Cost reduced (100 -> 80 G)
[*] Lorekeeper | Cost reduced (65 H + 25 BM -> 25 H + 50 BM)
[*] Garant | Cost reduced (40 G + 50 H -> 40 G + 30 H)
[*] Enclave | Prosperity points reduced (1-35-100 -> 1-26-70)
[*] Enclave | Recruitment options changed (Lvl 1 [strike]Civilian[/strike] -> Crawler XL)
[*] Bastion + Fortress | Recruitment options changed (Warrior + Civ. / Prideful / Ansturm -> Warrior + Prideful / Ansturm / X)
[*] Primordial Shrine + Celestial Temple | Recruuitment options changed (Silence artifact + Civilian + Summon primordial beast lv 2 / Lorekeeper / X ->  Silence artifact + Harbinger / Warrior + Lorekeeper / X)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

And that's all for today folks! 🫡

As usual - have fun, and do leave us a review if you like the game! ✨

⚔️ See you on the battlefield! ⚔️

Cheers,
The Chimera Team

notes.title: 🚀 Road to Launch #3 - Campaign & Difficulty Settings 🚀
notes.content:
Greetings, heroes of Songs of Silence! ⚔️

We continue our [i]Road to Launch[/i] series... (finally! 🥳)

This week, we give you an insight on [i]TWO[/i] key parts of ✨Songs of Silence✨!
[list]
[*]⚔️ [b]The Campaign[/b]
[*]⚖️ [b]The Difficulty Settings[/b]
[/list]
Early Access and player feedback (you!) enabled us to improve and even [b]rehaul certain chapters[/b]! 🛠️ 

This also fueled development for the rest of the campaign.

As for [b]Difficulty Settings[/b], both provided us with precious [b]balancing inputs[/b]! 💡

[h2]⚔️ The Campaign ⚔️[/h2]

[h3]📖 [i][b]Chapter 2[/b][/i][/h3]

When we released into Early Access, chapter 2 was [i]strongly[/i] criticized. 😤

It suffered from several issues, which led us to the following changes:
[list]
[*] We shortened and [b]rehauled the first section[/b] for a faster, simpler navigation 🗺️
[*] We improved the [b]movement meter[/b] to indicate when a player may hide or not 📏
[*] We reworked the [b]forests and armies[/b] placed in the [b]middle section[/b] to be more intuitive 🌲
[*] We fine-tuned the [b]AI[/b] to be less punitive 🩹
[/list]
Here's some before and after pictures below! 👇👇👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/656579412071e6ca4ad50384166e0297ab0e35de.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/73ece77ee487a82cd08998b16fcee938eb8b305d.jpg[/img]

[h3]⛰️ [i][b]Terrain & Decorations[/b][/i][/h3]

Between Early Access and 1.0 release, every campaign map (as well as skirmish) underwent a beautification pass. 💅

In practice, this meant adding...
[list]
[*] 3D decorations 🗿
[*] Improved terrain textures ⛰️
[*] Unique shaders and VFX 🌪️
[/list]
Before and after pictures below! 👇👇👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/b3c29e95da31b62acce8c00d83f4394b320b9a6c.jpg[/img]

[h3]🎁 [i][b]Secrets...[/b][/i][/h3]

A video game isn't really one without some secrets... 🤫

We [i]sparkled[/i] them throughout the campaign to incentivise [b]exploration[/b].

We don't want to spoil you, so here's a [i]hint[/i] of what to look out for... 😏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/53af2419431a990d0cb3f228c49c4ca3ece05630.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]
[h2]⚖️ Difficulty Settings ⚖️[/h2]

Its main objective: cater to multiple strategy playstyles - from [i]hardcore[/i] to [i]casual[/i].

Below is an overview - straight out of our Game Design documents - how [i]Difficulty Settings[/i] work.

[i][b]Armies[/b][/i]

Adjusting difficulties revolves around [b]neutral [/b]and[b] AI army compositions[/b]. 👹
[list]
[*] Adjust Hero levels / maximum army sizes
[*] Adjust army compositions for existing armies (neutral & AI)
[*] Adjust AI hero revive pools (max respawn with weaker / stronger armies)
[*] Adjust AI hero respawn timers
[*] Add additional neutral or AI armies to maps
[*] Add cards to AI Hero pools
[/list]
[i][b]Locations[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Adjust location balancing
[*] Adjust location starting state per difficulty (Prosperity level or ruined)
[/list]
[i][b]Objectives[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Adjust objectives dynamically between difficulty levels
[/list]
In a Campaign chapter, it would show like this! 👇👇👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/d7af289d0d0cecf86c24d6171da4af13c59f84a5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

And that's all for today folks! 🫡

As usual - have fun, and do leave us a review if you like the game! ✨

⚔️ See you on the battlefield! ⚔️

Cheers,
The Chimera Team

notes.title: Price Update for Release
notes.content:
We have important news about the game price for Songs of Silence as we approach its full release on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox.

First and foremost, let us express our deepest gratitude to everyone who has supported Songs of Silence so far. Your passion, feedback, and dedication have been instrumental in shaping the game into what it is today. With your support, our vision is now a reality, and we are forever honored and thankful.

As an independent studio striving to make our mark, we've been reflecting on how to bring Songs of Silence to an even wider audience. One key insight from Early Access is the profound impact of pricing on accessibility. 

Our research suggests that reducing the price, as a game transitions from Early Access to full release, is a step rarely, if ever, taken in the industry. Despite the uncertainty that comes with venturing into uncharted territory, this decision aligns with our core values and our commitment to our community.  

Therefore, we will be adjusting the base price of Songs of Silence from $39.99 to $29.99 for the 1.0 release, with corresponding changes to regional prices. 

We believe this new price point strikes the right balance between honoring the game's value and making it attainable for more players worldwide. Our goal is to welcome as many people as possible into the richly crafted world we've created.

We understand this change may come as a surprise, especially to our early supporters who purchased the game at the original price. Please know that this decision was made with the long-term vision of growing our community and ensuring the game's success. 

We value your opinions and invite you to share your thoughts with us. We've set up[url=https://forms.gle/FcqhkXg4FgNU5HGR6][b] a contact form where you can reach out directly[/b][/url], and we'll do our best to respond in the coming days and weeks.

We're incredibly excited about what the future holds for Songs of Silence and remain committed to delivering ongoing updates and new content post-launch. Your continued support fuels our passion, and we can't wait to embark on this next chapter together.

With heartfelt appreciation,
The Chimera Entertainment Team

notes.title: 🚀 Road to Launch #1 - 1.0 Release coming Nov. 13th 🚀
notes.content:
[i]Greetings[/i] - heroes of Songs of Silence! ⚔️

As we head towards launch, we're starting a new series called "[i][b]Road To Launch[/b][/i]". 

We want to highlight all the [b]cool features[/b] and [b]improvements[/b] Songs of Silence has received in [i]DETAIL[/i] throughout the many updates. Meaning "Behind the Scenes" info, the "Why's" and the "How's"...

But before that, we have a big announcement ...
[h2]🥳 We have a 1.0 Release Date - Nov 13! 🥳[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/369dacd0a7c63eeca9921d8d3bdbc2f4aa350b4d.png[/img]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iKwhf7G7cpk
Songs of Silence will release its 1.0 version on Steam (and consoles) November 13th!

[i](We hope you all are just as excited as we are)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/c113e1d25abddaa19a1da9e9d1579f4086e1f60c.png[/img]

That said, let's continue.

This is the first instalment of the [b][i]Road to Launch[/i][/b] series. It's a special moment ✨ as much of this was driven by [b]YOU[/b], our dedicated community! Today and in the coming weeks - we’ll take you through the significant milestones we’ve achieved together, thanks to your feedback, ideas, and support.

[h2]⚔️ An Overview of the Road to Launch! ⚔️[/h2]

Long ago, the Chimeras lived together in harmony. Then everything changed when we went into Early Access... [i]Wait what?[/i] 

Yes. That's where the story starts. The moment we went into Early Access, the day where we started talking to the Community Non-stop. 

You see, the moment we released, there was a small moment of hype. We celebrated, drank some apple juice, and were happy. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/3c3a8fccfbdc791c5beb8e64216fe6b707dd60d5.png[/img]

[h2]😱 Then the reviews came in... 😱[/h2]
[i]Some negative[/i] - Immediately, we got our toolboxes out. What was the issue? We are checking, reading, party mode long forgotten. There it is. Japanese Characters in unrelated translations. Oh no. 
How did this happen? Doesn't matter. What does is to listen. Immediately we make a post about it. 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/4182234368465978335?l=english
2 hours later we deliver the fix. But the damage was done. We struggle with the visibility. What a bummer. People have questions. [i]Why the negative reviews? What's up with the price? Why is the Crusade so overpowered?? Why did we lock everything??? [/i]All valid questions. Questions we answered the next day.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/4186738601581408974?l=english
And for everyone coming in after that, we made an edited version together with our Creative Director Alex, and our Publishing team. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tWqqsceBy9I

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h2]🔥 Hotfix 2.0: Early Unlocks and Faster Battles![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/4186738601585741984?l=english
Your feedback on the game’s pacing and accessibility sparked one of our earliest updates, and we knew we had to respond swiftly. With Hotfix 2.0, we introduced a series of quality of life improvements to streamline your experience.

✨ [b]Encyclopedia Revamp[/b]: We improved the UX/UI, offering clearer explanations for how to unlock content in Skirmish and Multiplayer. No more guessing—you’ll know exactly how to access your favorite heroes and armies!

✨ [b]Unlocks from the Start[/b]: We made sure that from the get-go, every faction starts with two hero vocations unlocked and the 4min Chess Fate is now available to all. No more slow starts—get into the action faster!

✨[b] Speed Up Battles[/b]: Yes, some battles felt slow. We understand. So, we added the speed up option! Now you can engage in combat at 2X and 4X speeds, so you can swiftly outmaneuver your enemies or experience quicker, more intense clashes!

✨[b] Exit & Load During Battle[/b]: This one almost everyone complained about. We didn't even think of it, before you voiced it - but you showed us why it made sense. So we’ve added the ability to exit and load games mid-battle for ultimate flexibility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h2]🛡️ Hotfix 3: Movement, Maps, and Deeper Immersion[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/6041096475587860516?l=english
The next phase of fixes was all about perfecting the flow and feel of the game. Especially Map 2 received a lot of backslash. The stealth mission we had invisioned did not work as intended, as the Map Terrain did not support it very well. So together with some bugs, we started a big rework.

✨[b] Movement UI[/b]: We’ve improved the movement meter and added better visual cues for hero movement points on their portraits—making it easier to plan your moves.

✨[b] Map 02 Tutorial Rework[/b]: Eila’s Guidance, and stealth mechanics, got a makeover, together with the whole Map 2 terrain. Now, learning how to navigate Map 02 feels smoother and more intuitive.

✨[b] Zoom-in Battle Depth[/b]: Oh, this one was a joy to bring. We’ve deepened the zoom in battles, so you can now appreciate the finer details of your armies clashing in the heat of battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h2]⚔️ Update 0.5.5: The Big Balancing Overhaul![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/4270057097450005006?l=english
You may ask, why did we switch from Hotfix to Update? For clarity, honestly. From that point, we weren't running around with our pants on fire anymore. We could plan. Hotfixes were helpful to communicate the urgency that came with Early Access launch. But now things had stabilized. :) 

Especially in our 0.5.5 Update, which brought in a big list of Balancing changes. We could not call that a Hotfix anymore, since we had adjusted so much. 
Let's also not go into details here. If checking out numbers is your think, feel free to read the Steam post, otherwise this would take a lot of space. :D 

⚖️ Crusade Nerf, Old Race Buff: The mighty Crusade received some well-deserved nerfs to balance their dominance, while the ancient Old Race has gained some much-needed buffs to bring them back into the competitive scene. This of course still isn't perfect, and we're adjusting the numbers all the time. Once day, we will have it perfectly. Once day...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h2]🏰 Update 0.6: Community Feedback FTW![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/4353376227583508897?l=english
This update was all about you—the players! Together with our Roadmap Features such as the Movement System rework, or Steam deck support, we took your feedback and built upon it, introducing some of the most highly requested changes.

🏰 [b]Garrison Aid in Sieges[/b]: You wanted it, and we thought it made sense. Your Garrison now joins the fight when you are besieged. Because why wouldn't they? This is a game-changer for early-game sieges, making defense more strategic and impactful.

🎵 [b]Music Settings for Streamers[/b]: Love the soundtrack? Now you can choose whether the music keeps playing when you switch windows—perfect for streamers and multi-taskers alike.

⚔️[b] AI Army Management[/b]: The AI is now smarter when managing units—healing in safe locations and leaving garrison troops for protection. Plus, allied armies can now move through occupied locations, optimizing their movement.

🌿 [b]Visual Overhauls[/b]: We updated the Wilderness biome on large maps with more details and procedural decoration. Whether it’s windmills or vegetation, the world feels more alive than ever!

✨ [b]Light Veins Visual Update[/b]: Sharper, brighter, and more visible—Light Veins on the map now stand out beautifully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h2]🎖️ Update 0.7: Choose Your Next Hero![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/4613462277091416632?l=english
Getting Erudite 3 times in a row, or never getting a Highlord when you started with the Hierophant (trust me, I speak from experience) It feels.. unfair. Especially if your enemy is putting out Arbiters one after another. A lot of you have requested to be able to choose your next hero. This was something more complicated to implement, so it took its sweet time. But for 0.7 we made it, and it enhanced the gameplay A LOT.

✨[b] Choose Your Hero[/b]: One of the most requested features is here—now, you can choose your next hero in single-player skirmish and multiplayer! Say goodbye to getting the same hero multiple times in a row. We agree—it’s neat!

🤼[b] Co-op Multiplayer[/b]: It's still in v.01, so it's not at its full potential yet. We see the vision already: Exchanging resources and Armies - that would be neat. But that system is overly complicated, it would add more resource management, and our backend is not made for it. So we delivered the first version - shared vision and friendly locations, so we can add up on it based on your feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h2]🧠 Update 0.8: Difficulty Levels & Community-Driven Enhancements[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/4656248375959274623?l=english
Last Update everyone! Not forever - for Early Access. That's it. Week after week we've been checking the feedback, discussed it with the team and implemented what made sense. It's been a ride - whew. But 0.8 was something important to deliver, and it brought some other great improvements!

🧠[b] AI Improvements[/b]: From better handling of lootwagons to making neutral AI more aggressive, we’ve improved how the AI behaves in various scenarios. They now traverse purgatories more effectively and no longer leave isolated armies wandering aimlessly.

🗺️ [b]Strategy Map Zoom-In & UI Toggle[/b]: Whenever you want to admire the beautiful locations, you can now zoom in closer on the map!

⚔️ [b]Quest Unlock Adjustments[/b]: Grinding be gone! Now, you only need to win 1 game to unlock quests, instead of 3—making progression smoother and faster.

[b]🚪 MP Lobby Exit Confirmation[/b]: We’ve added an exit confirmation popup when leaving the Multiplayer Lobby, making sure you don’t accidentally quit the game after waiting for that perfect match.

📜 [b]In-Game News Screen:[/b] Meet our friendly Kobold! He’s here to give you the latest news and updates right inside the game, so you’re always in the loop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h2]❓Where is 0.9❓[/h2]
Good Question! We got what we need. 

We really, like [i]really[/i] want to launch this game. And we think with all your feedback we're just at the right spot. So let's be a bit more patient, and wait for 1.0.

[h2]🛡️ The Road Ahead[/h2]
As we continue our journey toward launch, we are thrilled to have you by our side. Your insights, feedback, and suggestions have been invaluable in shaping Songs of Silence into the epic experience it’s becoming. Each update marks a milestone in our shared adventure, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next.

Thank you for being a part of this journey. 

[url=https://discord.gg/songs-of-silence-1068472676127100988][b]Join us in our Discord[/b][/url], be sure to grab the Private Tester role to participate in discussions and playtests. 

Let’s continue crafting this world together!

⚔️ Join the Battle, Shape the Future! ⚔️

tags.feature: ✨ Encyclopedia Revamp: We improved the UX/UI, offering clearer explanations for how to unlock content in Skirmish and Multiplayer. No more guessing—you’ll know exactly how to access your favorite heroes and armies!

notes.title: Third Major UPDATE - v.0.8.0 OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 
How did you like Update 2? Did you already have time to play Multiplayer or experience the new Community Feature [i]chose your Hero[/i]?

The past two weeks have been a ride! After finally bringing you our first version of Co-op (and having a blast on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/songsofsilence]Stream [/url]with it) and the highly awaited Community Features, we were so glad that you notice how we’re constantly improving the game!

[i]Even more[/i], after our Ukrainian language update 💙💛 The support has been immense – thank you so much! We’re happy we can bring you so much joy.

BUT WE HAVE MORE! Let’s not talk forever, let's see what this Update brings you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/89c33efe71a9f974682a4426aec69f17292315b2.png[/img]
 
[h3][ROADMAP FEATURE] Difficulty Levels![/h3]
As promised, we finally bring you the difficulty levels. Now, everyone can play at their own pace.
This also includes normal balancing changes, but since the list is so long, we won't go into details. Next time we hope to bring back our list of changes!
[list]
[*][b]Story Mode[/b]: For our story lovers, who want to explore the world of Songs of Silence, without the pressure of having to strategize deeply. Here you can sit back, enjoy the story and some matches – and get into the game!
[*][b]Balanced Mode[/b]: If you played Songs of Silence before – then nothing changed for you in terms of difficulty. Of course, we improved some balancing, based on your feedback. The game is reasonably challenging, but won’t have you dive deep into strategy optimization.
[*][b]Difficult Mode[/b]: You want to dive deep into unit formation, perk optimization and resource management in Songs of Silence? This mode is for you. Enjoy, and let us know what you think?
[/list]
[h3][COMMUNITY IMPROVEMENTS] AI Improvements [/h3]
Ah, yes. Our beloved AI – which needs to learn a lot still. It’s like a baby and you need to teach it things. We’re improving it all the time, here’s the current list of improvements.
[list] 
[*] Improved the AI reserves interaction; including better handling of lootwagons.
[*] Fixed neutral AI ignoring nearby armies. Neutral AIs will now be more aggressive. (yay!)
[*] Fixed isolated AI armies not finding a path to the opponent’s capital.
[*] Improved the AI to more reliably traverse purgatories.
[/list]
[h3][ROADMAP FEATURE] Battle & Army Statistics [/h3]
This is something you were asking for [i]from the very beginning[/i], and we heard you. It just took us some time, but we got you now. 
After each battle, you now have a little button called [b]Casualties[/b]. You'll find info about your army and that of your enemy – or what’s left of it 😉.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/2533b291b1dd7c77bdf5a8644a0e446ca652dd6a.png[/img]
[b]Some quick notes: The causalities [/b]
[list]
[*] Include units / combatants from Call Reserves
[*] Include units / combatants from Garrison
[*] Does [b]NOT [/b]include summoned units
[*] Includes up to 16 units per side
[/list]
We’re eager to hear your feedback – and of course which stats you would love to see in the future!

[h3][COMMUNITY FEEDBACK] Strategy Map Zoom-in & UI On/Off Toggle [/h3]
Close, Closer, Closest! You can now zoom in more on the strategy map, to have a look at our beautiful locations and environment. What is your favorite building or unit? Let us know! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/6bf08bcc77ab1bf8ad3cb58b1941f7f7d89b87d0.png[/img]
[h3][COMMUNITY FEEDBACK] Quest Unlock Adjustments [/h3]
We did it. We stopped the grind. Thank you so much for being vocal about the Quest unlocks and sharing your feelings about it. While we still think, that we should keep the Quests – as they gradually introduce you to the Hero’s or Factions mechanic, we made it much easier for you to unlock them. All you have to do is win only 1 game, instead of 3.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/8079030c22627c9ffcd01c9b9701f042741989e9.png[/img]And you can even speed that process up! Wanna know how? [url=https://discord.gg/songs-of-silence-1068472676127100988]Ask the Community on Discord![/url]😉

[h3][COMMUNITY FEEDBACK] Warning before Quitting MP Lobby ESC Key [/h3]
Recently, with new players coming in we got a lot of feedback regarding New Player Experiences [NPE]. The demand for confirmation popups is high, and we hear you. We are starting little by little, because we need to check the backend on multiple things. But rest assured, it’s on our list. 
For starters, we brought you the Confirmation when leaving the Multiplayer Lobby. We hope it enhances your experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/01138a64a64e2d6883d4cf97d506dc176a6ed50e.png[/img]

[h3][COMMUNITY FEEDBACK] In Game News Screen[/h3]
Meet our little Kobold friend! He is here to quickly bring you the latest news and fixes –[i] IN THE GAME[/i]. So next time there is a hotfix or big update, you can directly check it out. Neat, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/ed11019dc03c875e0b95049f38909fd412f4b3ba.png[/img]

[h3]BUGS SQUASHED[/h3] 
[list]
[*]Enemy army stuck in locations - FIXED! We adjusted the AI "rules", should not be an issue anymore
[*]Triune Tribunal of War now receives and deals damage (small oopsie)
[*]Garrison units do not disappear anymore from Wild Purgatories when travelling through them
[*]Void Summoning recruitment card is now playable in Wild Purgatories
[*]Fixed an Issue where the WASD Camera Navigation moved too fast
[*]Map 02: Improved the balancing for aggressive armies to make them feel more natural 
[*]Lightveins are (hopefully) not covered by vegetation anymore
[*]Fixed a bug where armies got stuck in locations. Now they can get out again!
 [/list]

[h3] [b]SNEAK-PEEK[/b]: Upcoming Beta Playtest for Map 5 & 6 - Join our Discord! [/h3]
Next week, we want to bring you a unique opportunity to experience Songs of Silence further and contribute to the game with your valuable insights & experience doing your thing – playing the game.

We’re looking for people who want to play Map 5 and 6 in advance, and give us feedback on balancing, the difficulty settings, and the overall terrain.

If you’re interested, great! [url=https://discord.gg/songs-of-silence-1068472676127100988]Join our Discord, and grab your “private Testers” role[/url] once we go live with the beta, to get access.


That’s it!
pretty big update, right? That’s because we want to create the best version of Songs of Silence that we can. Your feedback has been shaping the game a lot, and we are looking forward to hear your feedback!
Until then, enjoy playing – and see you all on the battlefield! ⚔️

The Chimera Entertainment Team

notes.title: Second Major UPDATE - v.0.7.0 OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello Comrades!

You don't know how happy we are to bring you this update. 
Thanks again for all your amazing feedback and suggestions from our last update! With those in mind, we now present to you our next major update from our updated Roadmap! 👇👇👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/46aa5be6680ceaa7be1336b56a7135bffab1b7bf.png[/img]
Some of our fans might notice, this one looks different. So, to get the most important message out already: yes, we updated our Roadmap!
We realized we need a bit more time with the Difficulty Settings (being at Gamescom was an amazing – but also time-consuming experience...) so we’re going to bring them with v.0.8.0.

[h3][ROADMAP FEATURE] Co-op Multiplayer![/h3]
It’s finally happening - [b]Co-op v.01 is available RIGHT NOW[/b]! One note, we know this feature can still be improved, your feedback and suggestions will be precious to make it even more enjoyable! Please feel free to hop on our Discord Server and leave feedback! We read it, promise. 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/539c697b17f5feb65a1d3c3d91492c0c93082add.png[/img]
Here's a breakdown of what you can expect, for now:
[list]
[*]Set up to [b]3 different teams[/b].
[*] [b]Allies share the same victory condition[/b]. You win only if all players of the opposing teams are eliminated, but you can still be eliminated individually.
[*] [b]All allies share their vision[/b], including info on hidden armies
[*] Players can [b]move through allied armies & locations[/b] – but not enter them!
[/list]
[h3][COMMUNITY FEEDBACK] Choose your Next Hero![/h3]
This is a feature YOU wanted from the very beginning. So we are happy to introduce you to the [i]long, long and rightfully awaited[/i] [b]“Choose your Next Hero” option for single-player skirmish and multiplayer[/b]! 

No more getting Erudite 3x in a row... This way, you have options. Neat, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/2ea6fbafcb90c0bd4c71bcbf541561d6456bc37d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/6acebb81d3fbaabb68dd37f4e3af75cfd821fd1e.png[/img]
Oh, we’re also bringing SOS on GOG, but you’re already here on Steam, so that’s not a biggie. 😉 Check out our Social Media posts for more news about this! 

[h3]Balancing Updates[/h3]
None. We’re gonna bring them with the Difficulty Levels in the next Update. 😉 Stay tuned!

[h3]Bugs squashed[/h3] 
[list] 
[*]Map 01 - Dialogues are not retriggered when retreating from initial battle anymore.
[*]Unrest State - Fixed a bug where the unrest State persisted even when replacing an existing building in a location. 
[*]Input Device Dropdown - The dropdown menu for input devices does not vanish anymore after entering a match room. 
[*]Siege Exit - Armies inside a location under siege used to be able to exit the location in [i]Skirmish[/i] / [i]Multiplayer[/i] modes. Now they can’t. 
[*]Battle Biome - You now enter the correct battle biome when breaking a siege as a defender.

notes.title: First Major UPDATE - v.0.6.0 OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Already teased in our Livestreams (what, you didn’t know we have a Twitch channel? Check it out here: https://www.twitch.tv/songsofsilence ) we have been working on some nice improvements and are happy to bring you our first major update from our Early Access Roadmap!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/1449ba255d5c79d9eeb5e49d68a9761c35b132cc.png[/img]
Quality of life, but also one big bugfix that will make the AI feel better [i]and smarter[/i]. Already brought to our private beta branch. Read more here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/4270057097475752261?l=english. 
We carried over a bugfix that now [b]allows AI armies to enter their own locations to stash in their gold, recruit new units & heroes. We hope that makes the Skirmish even more fun![/b]
But, there’s more!

[h2] [Roadmap Feature] Movement System Rework[/h2]
Motivated by feedback from our dear Community, and the team, we aimed to improve the UX and quality of live. It is now easier to move & sneak past units on the map, as we adjusted the control zones. The movement calculation make more sense now, and you can even make the more complicated trips – close to rivers or mountains (to a degree – of course)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/6fa20f8e0e75d431a4a441b0a6bb85b048e64f94.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/c28f845d7a3962fe17246520e8b877b2e27a7db9.png[/img]

[h2] [Roadmap Feature] SteamDeck & Controller Support[/h2]
We heard some of you like to play on their SteamDeck, or with Controllers. We improved the input system, and the UI. And yes, we adjusted the font size too. We hope it helps!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/e1b9fb57effb82db2dc8abcae83fd6e536e4f397.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/5a3e841f02e2c6bdc4517d2c2adda2d556900991.png[/img]

Hoping to overcome the issue with early game sieging and preventing it – and to make the garrison more impactful – we decided to let the Garrison join you in the fight when you try to break a siege. Now your enemies will think twice, before they attack you!

[h2] [Community Feedback] Added Settings to let Music play when using another Window[/h2]
Especially important for our streamers, you can now decide whether you want the music to play or to stop when checking out another window. Our Songs of Silence Music is great, so why not keep listening to it in the background?

notes.title: We got some news! | Upcoming Updates | Indie Booth Arena | Events
notes.content:
You know, we don’t like to keep you in the dark about the development of Songs of Silence, and since there won’t be a game update this week (but hopefully early next week!) we think it’s at least time to tell you what happened so far, and we’re planning! 

[h2] Next Update coming soon! [/h2] 
We know, you’re waiting for the next update. And we hope to bring it soon. But we already have good news – this will be a bigger one! Remember the Roadmap we shared? 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/eac62d3702e6e09ec47212929b69b5c0221ce3e4.png[/img]
The next Update 0.6.0 will also be our first Update from our Roadmap! Movement System Rework and Improved Controller Support is something we’ve been wanting to work on for a while now, and it’s coming very soon! Oh, and we can already let you know we also have some Community Feedback implemented, which were shared by our fans on our Discord server. Thank you all for sharing your ideas and suggestions!  
Do you have an idea on how we can improve Songs of Silence? Let us know on our Discord Server https://discord.gg/songs-of-silence-1068472676127100988 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[b]IMPORTANT[/b]: This update will invalidate your previous Map 2 save files, but not impact your achievements. 
[b]While we’re at important notes[/b]: Since we fixed an issue with the Encyclopedia stats for the location counter, your counter will be reset to 0. We’re sorry about this inconvenience. But this update allows us now to track & display the locations counter correctly. Thank you for understanding.  
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h2] We are at Gamescom! Indie Arena Booth here we come! [/h2] 
Do you want to try out Songs of Silence in person while talking to the team? Great! We will have a booth at this year’s Indie Arena Booth at Gamescom. Come and say hi! We will have some Goodies for you 😊

Community Manager Ilcin and Head of Staff Winnie had the opportunity to present Songs of Silence, and we were so happy to see everyone trying out our game and enjoying it. We’re grateful to everyone who stopped by and said hi! (Images by StMD)

notes.title: Dev Diary #13 - Our Environment
notes.content:
You know how the saying goes: [i]Recycle, Reuse, Optimize the environment pipeline[/i]. Wait, what? You heard right. Let’s talk environment. This has been overdue for way too long.

Songs of Silence is more than your average 4x strategy game (which is by the way the perfect game to play in one evening with your friends).

Songs of Silence is also a [b]beautiful [/b]and [b]aesthetically pleasing[/b] game. You probably already noticed our art nouveau style illustrations, and last time we covered some VFX by our Technical Artists. But what about literally everything else you see on the map? 

Have you ever taken a moment to appreciate the beautiful environment where you let your armies march all over? These lush forests, spiky mountains and calming atmosphere? ([i]Unless you’re running into a battle, of course[/i].) 

[previewyoutube=RhRyltctZkQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/3f0061bd4ba38943c2a6d34b098136d9385f2115.jpg[/img]

You might think: “[i]Why are we talking about this? The Game designers tell the environment team what they want, the team creates the maps, and that’s it.[/i]”

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Hearthlands Biome[/th]
        [th]Meadow Biome[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/0179460c9c6149b26cd995e846264db7a356bc3b.jpg[/img][/td]
        [td style="text-align: center;"]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/dc1abc920ca36251ebbda6d9413135580bd04e4c.jpg[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
   [tr]
        [th]Wilderness Biome[/th]
        [th]Snowfields Biome[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
         [td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/4f7967d49c65585f2a1d5009679b06c38ed09485.jpg[/img][/td]
        [td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/309171b0d57c62bc20171e9b4f7999b81636d684.jpg[/img]
[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
Ah, we wish it was this easy. But no worries. We made it this easy. Kinda. You see, our Game Design team wants [b]full control[/b] over the design, but having to add changes each time Game Design tested a map and realized they did want to change it, was just too much overhead. Our Lead Environment artist is also working on battlegrounds, biomes, colors, assets… he kinda does everything. And he came up with an amazing idea: 
[i]Optimize and automize the process for Game Design to create maps by simply using a 2D image that looks like the one on the left:[/i]

[table noborder=1]
   [tr]
       [td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/afc53ecf9655bf4189a1422b7c53d7cba3a23f3d.png[/img]
       [/td]
[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/f1cb6edbd5277b8588a2c5cc0e9943d779f637fb.png[/img]
[/td]
   [/tr]
[/table]
Some of the hardcore Songs of Silence fans might even recognize it. This is our Campaign Map 1, where Lorelai meets Hauser and searches for a new home. Can you see the similarities?

You might ask: “[i]How does that 2D image turn out to become this pretty 3D map?[/i]”

Good question! Let’s dive deeper into what our Lead Environment Artist has set up. Here’s a breakdown for the pipeline:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/da29eee5f96f2b060cdd2b036c4913fafeac6a59.png[/img]

And from the moment Game Design paints their maps, up until bringing everything together, everything is automized. Crazy, right? Let’s dive into each step one by one so you can see what happens behind the scenes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h1]1. Photoshop[/h1]
Our Game Designers work in a specific Photoshop file, where each layer is assigned a different color. They paint a Gameplay map, which you can see above, and a biome map. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/0c96e01f8e4814234bcbe78f0a434cf2312f5606.gif[/img]
Each color has a different meaning:

[list]
    [*]Red: Mountain region (Gameplay element)
    [*]Blue: Water and rivers (Gameplay element)
    [*]Green: Forests & trees (Gameplay element)
    [*]Purple: Locations (Gameplay element)
    [*]White: Roads (Decoration element)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h1]2. Houdini[/h1]
No, not the magician. The program. We have a Houdini server that utilizes .bat files to generate the maps, once it has the layers in the correct place in the Unity folder. Game Design executes the .bat file, and in 10-15 minutes the adapted terrain is available in unity. 

And this is what’s happening in the background:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/8639b03d1c3be5385c29e94ad4f808be79de8aaf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/93045296d52df29d3b8016e972c7ef168a5028da.gif[/img]

The first thing that happens in Houdini is the creation of the mountain. Its erosion, height, noise and terrace are calculated with highly complex and fast mathematical operations that could not be executed by a single person (It probably could, but it would take forever). These calculations define the shape of the mountains based on our parameters, to give it the Songs of Silence Art Nouveau look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/30890125a0b56fb97585e5c692c5d5ab2e06a2ef.jpg[/img]

The biggest challenge here was to make sure the mountains are exactly in the space Game Design painted them in: only in the red area of the 2D texture. Otherwise, our units can’t pass.
The next task is calculation the water bodies and the terrain underneath, considering coasts, beaches and smoothened erosion.

[previewyoutube=dbRoVORuX68;full][/previewyoutube]

Once we got the mountains and the waterbodies, they’re put into a block in Houdini, which then gives us the needed masks for Unity as an output. These are:
[list]
    [*]Heightmap
    [*]Flowmap
    [*]Detailed map
    [*]Texture masks
    [*]Normal maps
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/3548f8e147ebec213c09cb28f5d4cd0f527df90f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h1]3. Substance Designer[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a7468375f3c6a78d2df7edcd76985b17a7b4e6e0.png[/img]
These masks are then imported into Substance to visualize the texturing. Here, through complex nodes being put together (really, ask our Environment Artist for details, this looks like magic) and using only the output from Houdini, we create new textures to be used and imported in Unity. 
Here we put in Biome color, street textures, Lightveins for the Darkside, Snow and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/cbde8fd2b6a417d930d2d1760b1dd1ed1a31eec6.gif[/img]

[b]Fun fact[/b]: Did you know: Lightvein positions are random - but also not? They depend on the mountain’s erosion and are placed randomly in a place that makes sense. Those are crazy details to consider!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h1]4. Unity[/h1]
Once we have all the textures and maps we need, we import them into Unity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/ef245c19de0aa3b51962b17c4351945da7ae32f9.png[/img]
Finally, we have something visible. A displacement map is generated by the heightmaps. The normal maps and textures give it the final polish to become a beautiful terrain. So, what else is left? You’re right! Assets! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/18c0461852b70a6251a8caf88852881254e6c0f2.png[/img]

Unity is where the population pass happens. Based on a Generation Script written by our developers, our  Environment Artist can set up a Config file, where – taking the map design by our Game Designers into consideration – parameters like amount, radius and weight are defined. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/b54e2f63dd6b13bf9cf60b551f6c57cbdca9a07f.png[/img]

In short: This script spawns the assigned asset (e.g tree) based on the magical numbers our Environment Artist determines is best for each biome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h1]5. & 6. Substance & Unity [/h1]
After finishing the terrain and being happy with it, our Environment Artist can go in and do another pass to create the decoration textures and import them into Unity. This “decoration pass” is a [b]procedurally generated VFX layer[/b] based on the decoration texture. This way we can define where random props are placed, where beaches are or, where fishes spawn in the ocean, or where gusts of wind are allowed.
Thanks to our Config files, these assets (fishes, leaves in the wind, stones & rocks, etc.) can all be Biome specific. Makes sense, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/faf6af52468209fcdacf80b8d56bc65d46bd6e78.gif[/img]

Take your time to have a closer look at our strategy map and its environment. You will always find details. Promise!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/47d55a3c74bef5dbb448ec30976457d6ca8e5e36.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

That’s a huge pipeline. A lot of time and effort has been poured into making this a reality, to give our Game Designers something easy to work with. 
Our Lead Environment Artist has been working on this since the first prototype of Songs of Silence, and we could not be prouder of this accomplishment. It allows us to work independently while keeping the visual style and artistic vision set by our creative and art director. 

Songs of Silence is truly a [b]project of passion and immensely skilled individuals[/b], which made this huge project a reality. A big thank you to the team! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/7e68b3d9fde95e005119e81350f96f4affa1c3fc.png[/img]

Let us know which other details you can find on the map in your playthrough! And as always, stay tuned for the next news!
Cheers! 
The Chimera Team

notes.title: UPDATE 0.5.5 - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
As always, we’ve been working hard! It took us a bit more time, because we received so much feedback on Map 02 and balancing (yes - Arbiter is OP - we heard you!) that we first had to work through it. Also, playtesting the changes and getting it through QA takes its sweet time. How do they say? “[i]A game is not made within a day[/i]” – or something.

But enough of that, here’s what changed!

[h3]PATCH NOTES[/h3]
[b]Rebalanced Old Race Faction[/b]
To bring the Old Race up to par with our other factions, we increased the power for some units, and reduced cooldowns / costs. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/4270057097450005006]You can find more detailed patch notes here[/url]

[b]Rebalanced Crusade Faction[/b]
Ah, the Crusade. We overhauled the Crusade economy and adjusted power levels and cooldowns of Crusader hero cards. To improve gameplay on the map, we reduced building costs. We also took away some of Arbiter’s powers, and hope he is now more enjoyable to play. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/4270057097450005006]For more patch notes, check here.[/url]

[b]Rebalanced 1000 Kingdoms Faction[/b]
To make sure the 1000 Kingdoms can keep up with the other factions, we also buffed the archers and Monster Hunters, as well as Acolytes of Rites, Divine Spark and Divine Intervention. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195410/view/4270057097450005006]Check out detailed patch notes here.[/url]

[b]Automatic building upgrade when upgrading building card[/b]
This is a major improvement for your resources. 📈 Now, whenever you upgrade a building Strategy card, the buildings which have already been placed on your locations will automatically be upgraded to that level. Have fun with all the gold! 

[b]Multiplayer Quick Join improvement[/b]
When searching for a match, the “no match found” notification popped up immediately. With this improvement, the game searches for a game for a defined period and renews its search in the background, before any new popup opens.

[b]Increase number of Autosaves recorded + add parameter in Settings[/b]
In the settings, you can now determine how many autosaves you want to record as you play a map. This works for both single-player modes (Campaign & Skirmish) and multiplayer.

And of course, we got rid of some nasty bugs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h3]BUGS SQUASHED[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where autosaves of other chapters were deleted when finishing a campaign map.
[*] Frame rate cap video settings are now saved when closing the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Multiplayer match didn’t end after defeating all other players.
[*] Resolved an exploit allowing players to obtain the quest achievement by reloading just before completing a map.
[*] Changed the Luckstone artifact display of digits.
[*] Monodika “Scion of the Wild” hero does not start with 2 units on the same slot anymore.
[*] Fixed an issue where the last autosave broke after exiting during the world turn
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]
[h3]KNOWN ISSUES[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Void Effigy building card displays Void as income instead of building material while giving building material. It should display building material.
[*] Kantor “Void Herald” starts with a purgatory level up available which does not work. The level up should be removed.
[*] Unit formations become distorted when they are moved many (many) times between 2 ally armies on the army exchange screen.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

And now - enjoy the new update and let us know what you think with a 👍!
Cheers!
The Chimera Team

notes.title: New patch coming today - Battle Speed & Main Menu | Speed Chess Mode | Bugfixes
notes.content:
[b]Hello! [/b]

Firstly, a thank you! 

We’ve been live for about 48 hours now, and we’re so happy to see so many people buying, playing, and enjoying the game. Your feedback, good or bad, is important to us, and we are listening to it all. We’re about to drop the first hotfix, addressing some of the comments and constructive criticism we’ve received over the last two days. 

We are listening, and we are grateful to you all for bearing with us during the early access period and providing us with so much helpful information. As you can see from this patch, we’re working hard to implement your feedback and improve the game as quickly and thoroughly as possible. 

[b]But let's move on to the details of the update. [/b]
In terms of gameplay mechanics, two clear criticisms became apparent to us: the way content is unlocked for Skirmish and Multiplayer and how that is communicated in-game, and the inability to quit directly from a battle or to speed up the battle’s progress. 

This first patch, which will be released within the next 24 hours, addresses both issues and adds the Korean language pack!

[b]Content Unlocks[/b]
For the unlocking of content, we’ve both improved the UX/UI around the encyclopedia quests you need to complete to unlock content, and we’ve unlocked two heroes from each faction to play with right from the start. 

For the Crusade, that’s the Purgatory Shepherd, a ‘vocation’ or sub-class of the Arbiter Hero type - this awe-inspiring leader ravages entire armies with his destructive powers while commanding a particularly powerful Purgatory; and the Void Herald vocation for the Kantor class. This Kantor belongs to the Congregation of Dhana's Love and specializes in strong defense, healing, and building temples.

The Old Race gets the Medico vocation for the Monodika class - this Monodika has developed strong healing abilities, and her capital city allows the immediate recruitment of Harbinger units. In addition, the eyeless ones will have access to the Stonesinger vocation for the Konstruktor hero. A Konstruktor of very rare talent. His workshops, the fabled Konstruktoriums, are more developed than normal and immediately available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/31b73eb785cf507220af6544405e4d820a273845.png[/img]

The UX/UI improvements to the Encyclopedia make it much easier to understand what you should do next to unlock the content you’re looking for, as shown in the screenshots below. We know that it felt a little frustrating not to be able to find this information easily previously - this makes it much clearer what’s needed to get to the next unlock stage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/31d7a9edbb349beed4cc62803fa320b0a7b01f8c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/c5a403f5b098c91d8e21a46ae8c785eba1820122.png[/img]

[b]Battle Speed[/b]
Sometimes, you might want to save the enemy some blushes by fast-forwarding a battle where you’re embarrassing them. Now you can double or even quadruple the battle speed to deliver swift justice, or maybe save a few blushes of your own…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/8348a093277112f3500ae7b945a2cd4d786a317b.png[/img]

[b]Main Menu in Battle[/b]

We’ve also added the ability to be able to reload a previous save from the midst of battle, or to make a complete tactical withdrawal to the main menu if things are going really badly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/3c03ac71d9c95270d2867f7144a786b303ddbc30.png[/img]

[b]Speed Chess Mode[/b]
Finally, we have our new four-minute, time-limited turn mode unlocked from the first time you play the game; it's convenient if you’re engaging in multiplayer with a foe prone to going AFK or spending too much time perfecting their strategic decision-making.


[b]Stealth and Ambushes[/b]
We've seen that folks have been struggling with the stealth system introduced in Map Two. And maaaaaaybe it was a little harsh. So we're looking at a rework of how some of the stealth and ambush systems work to make them a little less brutal - this will be in a patch coming in next 24h!

But we're not going to leave you hanging over the weekend, either. We've implemented a small fix in this patch, which will increase the size of the forests you can hide in, giving Lorelai's army a better chance of sneaking past under the cover of the canopy. Good luck!

Before:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/f8fd48607e1bcdfc8258b9167e9539ab560fc32a.png[/img]

After:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/c4aa0c109baeb8711a17cd41980325c9e2959e27.png[/img]

[b]UPDATES[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved UX/UI and better explanations for content unlocking in Skirmish and Multiplayer
[*] Two heroes unlocked for each faction from the start
[*] Four-minute Speed Chess mode unlocked from the start
[*] 2X & 4X Battle speeds
[*] Korean language pack added
[/list]

[b]BUGS SQUASHED[/b]

Obviously, no hotfix is complete without a list of squashed bugs. See below for the things we’ve fixed so far!
[list]
[*] Loot wagons description error regarding the "Supply" perk
[*] "Zzz" VFX displayed on aggressive, neutral armies
[*] Player stuck in location along with enemy AI - mitigated (90% fixed)
[/list]

All best,

Chimera Team

notes.title: Songs of Silence Early Access - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
We are so proud to present the [b]first playable version of Songs of Silence in Early Access[/b]! It’s been a long road, we've been working on this game for 4 years now,  but our journey doesn’t end here - over the next few months we’re going to be fine-tuning everything about the game, adding new features, balancing mechanics and incorporating your feedback before the V 1.0 release in early Autumn. Until then, expect the occasional hiccup as we put the last few wires into place behind the scenes - you can find a mostly complete list of known issues below, as well as the roadmap for our development focus.

Whilst we’re managing expectations, please do remember that we are a relatively small team and whilst we’re going to be working as hard as we can over the next months, there may be times when we fall behind schedule or have to prioritise certain fixes over others. We’ll obviously try and minimise this, but please bear with us in these final stages - we want to get this right for you. We’d also love to hear your feedback over the course of the Early Access period - you can [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2195410/discussions/6/]submit bugs here[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2195410/discussions/3/]vote for which feature you’d like us to develop next here[/url]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h2]ROADMAP:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/eac62d3702e6e09ec47212929b69b5c0221ce3e4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h2]KNOWN ISSUES:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]AI Behavior[/b]: The AI sometimes does not act optimally, such as preferring to recruit units over building their base or being too defensive or aggressive.
[*][b]Movement[/b]: The movement system can be overly restrictive, requiring manual navigation around objects on the world map.
[*][b]Multiplayer[/b]: If you disconnect due to a connection loss, it is recommended to let the game host reload the game from the last turn save and rejoin via the lobby. Otherwise you will be replaced by AI.
[*][b]Tooltips & UI[/b]: Minor UI glitches may occur, such as tooltips overlapping or not updating correctly when reviving units.
[*][b]Map Overview Screen[/b]: Small visual glitches may appear on the overview map screen, particularly when observing AI behaviour or inspecting.
[*][b]Battle[/b]: There can be minor inconsistencies in combat, such as units getting blocked by others or unit formations mirroring incorrectly during an enemy's turn. Small issues might also arise when stacking multiple unit effects.
[*][b]Translations[/b]: You may encounter smaller translation issues, such as hard-to-understand or inconsistent tooltip translations in your language. Please help us identify these points.
[*][b]Performance[/b]: Playing on maximum size skirmish maps with many AIs will require higher performance, which might lower FPS or increase calculation times on low-spec PCs.
[*][b]Auto-saves[/b]: Exiting the game while it's auto-saving may corrupt the current turn's auto-save game. We recommend not exiting the game during the AI turn or ensuring you have a manual save from this turn if you want to.
[/list]

We hope you have a lot of fun playing Songs of Silence, and we can't wait to hear your feedback! Hop on to our Steam [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2195410/discussions/6/]Subforums for Bug reporting[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2195410/discussions/3/]feature requests here[/url] - so we can improve the game even further!

But until then - see you on the battlefield!
The Chimera Team

notes.title: Dev Diary #12 - Technical Artists - Tech or Artists?
notes.content:
Hey folks, 
it is time for another Dev Diary! It's been a while - huh?
You’ve already heard about our cards, our art and our voice actors, so let’s spice it up! Do you know how the part of the game that you can see comes together? That’s the magic of our Technical Artists 🪄 

[h3]Technical Artists[/h3] take the produced assets - be it buildings, characters or cards - bring them into the game, and make sure they’re connected properly so that they don’t only look pretty but are also functional.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]
Interested? Then let’s have a look at some [b]Cards of Fate[/b], shall we? 
The process to reach the final VFX stage is as follows: 
The Designers design a card and describe the look and mechanic, information which is collected in [i]super-secret lists[/i]. 
At the end, each card entry contains the name, the faction it’s assigned, which hero can play the card and how it should look in the game. 
Our artists then take this information, and, knowing the visual style of our game the best, translate it into a Card artwork, like these:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/e9454ce5f6bb89ab2d03e7f79a58a3de4c4264cf.png[/img]

Once a [b]Developer[/b] has implemented the mechanics to make this card work, it’s our Technical Artists turn. They have a look at the secret list and the card artwork, then make the [b]VFX [/b]come to life ✨. 
When they have a version they can show, they post it to our artists and designers to get feedback. [b]That’s it! Thanks for reading![/b]

Of course not! There is more to it. VFX can go through many iterations until we get the final look to feel and play right. Let’s take our Heavenly Scouts card, for example. You might remember this look from the old Demo:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/8a4641c27566f1a1b0ade4e8d9e9727783dd7175.gif[/img]

[h3]But after having created so many VFX,[/h3] [i]we knew we could do better[/i]. So that’s what we did! 
We adjusted the play effect by adding [b]more glowing circles[/b] around the army, highlighting the area. The symbol for Heavenly scouts now shows up later, with [b]more glow, particles and rays[/b], highlighting it to give it more visibility. The symbol also [b]stays longer[/b], giving the player time to appreciate the effect. Then, the lasting effect, which is visible for the card’s duration, got a [b]stronger glow[/b] at the bottom, and is accompanied by [b]golden birds at the top[/b], just like in the card artwork. In the end, it looked like this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/3b1120c2b5702ff8121b78ceafbfd057af791c0d.gif[/img]

This improvement process was done also for other cards, like Divine Revenge. This card [b]deals damage to the enemy if your unit dies[/b]. To visualize this, we had... nothing. 
So, we added a neat effect! The [b]sword from the card artwork pierces the affected area[/b]. The affected units [b]glow from within their bodies[/b], ready to unleash the [b]divine power[/b] to damage their enemies if they die in battle. A sword above their head marks them. 

[table]
[tr]
[th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/0059c34613a760d93e29b882a8b5bc9e233173e7.png[/img]
[/th]
[th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/5cd540ef0e4437095472f1d17470558d28d282ac.gif[/img][/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h3]Divine Intervention,[/h3] the card that summons Luminant knights onto the battlefield to aid your cause, look like this:

[table]
[tr]
	[th]Before[/th]
	[th]After[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/7bf19837678b88557f15cb33b0e86a30ceed9085.gif[/img]
       [/td]
	[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/8efd377a7cf510e881039e16d36a20324ee80c6b.gif[/img]
       [/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

To give it the[b] celestial vibe[/b] it deserves, we improved the build-up, adding more golden swirls that focus on a point of energy before exploding and raining [b]down in a divine shower[/b] which spawn the Luminant knights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

We also have a[b] little special card[/b] for you, one that has come with our new Demo update, along with a new neutral hero for you to play!

[h3]Fool’s gold! [/h3]
This Card makes a pile of gold appear on the battlefield. Blinded by their greed, the enemies rush to the pile, unaware that it 💥[b]explodes [/b]💥after a while, bringing them to their demise. To create this effect, first we started by [b]creating the coins falling from the sky[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a65d8f16dc2b7f337ec3f55cecf8891b39a181ed.gif[/img]

Adding a particle effect with a coin mesh and the corresponding texture, we added a collision to make them bounce off the ground. 
For the pile of gold itself, we utilized some performance tricks. Instead of creating a mesh with hundreds of coins, we simulated coins falling on a pile in blender, to extract the coin texture into photoshop. We added some layers, to color it properly, and finally created a simple, low-poly mesh in the shape of a pile to add the coin texture. It works wonders! 

[previewyoutube=2Qr3a3ia-pw;full][/previewyoutube]

Finally, adding a [b]shader [/b]with a moving texture, some glow below the pile, some shadows, and sparkles coming from the magical coins,[i] the gold looks really tempting[/i], right? But there’s more to bring it all together! Some dust while the coins fall and the pile grows, a golden swirl highlighting the affected area upon playing the card, and the explosion effect with coins flying everywhere make this effect truly fun to watch and play. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/850c8d6ef44800f930b2a587cdede11b14c3ffa1.gif[/img]

Cool, right?
You might have noticed our cards have different colors. (Duh, you knew that already, you read our Dev Diaries!) We just covered some of the Battle cards (red), what about our strategy cards (blue)? Let’s look at the Adventure Card!
This one has been in the Demo for a long time, but we often got feedback that we should have more visual support to make them distinguishable. And you were right. Look at this, if it weren’t for the card, would you know you could explore this location? 

[table]
[tr]
	[th]Before[/th]
	[th]After[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/805dc28ad7c3157557f849c7d1fc45a74f98d015.gif[/img]
       [/td]
	[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/7dd391e32100c371617ae229dca02ce2a699b14d.gif[/img]
       [/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Rhetorical question, of course not. So, we added a visual cue to make the location stand out more. Behind closed doors is something for you, and you get curious. But how can you figure it out? By dragging the Card over it? Exactly! And only after you’ve explored that location, does it return to normal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h3]Encamp Army[/h3] is a new card, that you can try out on your own! But a simple hint:[i] It helps you a lot![/i] 
Of course, you can build your camp around your unit while it’s not moving! Great for managing multiple units! 
But how did it look like? Well, like... nothing?

[table]
[tr]
	[th]Before[/th]
	[th]After[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/b706330684c7e278e0c142d63949d5aeac359570.gif[/img]
       [/td]
	[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/eab045d0fbc0495a3ec23106c332a3784c532c72.gif[/img]
       [/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

So, we added some play effects consisting of some [b]grey and golden construction smoke[/b] (so it’s visible on the light and dark side). After it’s gone, a [b]small camp surrounds the army[/b], consisting of tents, a small watchtower and a barricade, making sure no one enters. A small [b]golden glow[/b] ensures that the camp has good contrast on all types of grounds. 
Only after you move will the camp get destroyed and disappear. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

[h3]In Songs of Silence,[/h3] you can not only manage your army, but also your Kingdom, or any location you possess, providing you have the required materials. Each location can have one additional building, like the [b]Golden Temple[/b], which you’ve seen and used in the Demo. This card [b]increases your Divine Favor income[/b] and grants you knew recruitment options. But did you know it has some lore behind it? 
At the top of the temple, bodies that have passed away are being burned, so they can ascend to the Celestials. But the old building implementation didn't show any of it!

[b]So, we asked our artists![/b] And they provided us with these overpaints! It’s not really visible here, but it got the point across: [b]Add blue smoke with golden sparkles.  [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/19538afe124be07e8547fd4166ff2f56e8849f4f.png[/img]
So, that’s what we did! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/e3cf6a75009f592d9c42d21dcbbeed76ec8a7bb8.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

Additionally, we added more recruitment VFX. Before, in our old demo when you recruited a new unit, nothing happened, and the [b]unit popped into existence out of nowhere[/b]. To show their different nature, we divided the recruitment options into 4 different ones with unique effects, which you can see here:

[table]
[tr]
	[th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a2bd8e0297e1a5e231f94a82674d6d3acf4bff16.gif[/img]
[/th]
	[th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/64684434d92a328aad2525fed89ecdb6f5715ac9.gif[/img]
[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/aefbce26675003672ce8c7e5bad175c969673954.gif[/img]
[/td]
	[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/6bf5ff3a048585e05f030976fcd71b837458d6ea.gif[/img]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]


[h3]You know what’s the hardest part of these VFX?[/h3] Making them fit into our yellow biome. To find that perfect color balance that fits into a dark or green or red or YELLOW biome. You know why this is so hard? Because almost [b]ANY sparkling and golden glow effect gets lost in our yellow biome[/b]!
You can best see it on these Lootwagon Effects. Each color represents another rarity. 

On the [b]darker side, the colorful sparkles and swirls are well visible[/b] and give shape to the light beam. To make these also visible on our green and yellow biomes, we[b] added a black glow behind the beams[/b]. They’re not visible in the dark biome, not only give depth to the beams in the lighter biomes, but also add contrast to make them visible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/fbbdb75d0ac63d15dcafc0b7ca9868e9b940becf.png[/img]

For different ways of how we handled contrast, simply look at this fire effect:

[table]
[tr]
	[th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/cfea001cb03afda5d6d700013012a585c8e7f8b1.png[/img]
[/th]
	[th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/19c4ff75653a5edb66d8daed67da7ec720fe3aad.png[/img]
[/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

Even if it's small, you notice the [b]red fire of doom immediately on the dark side map[/b], but the black smoke gets lost. It’s exactly the [b]other way around on the light side map[/b]. For this effect, we made use of the main colors present, and added them in a well contrast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43578526/a8f75e4f9038db2b4180d37f0f778613d3e0711c.png[/img]

As you see, we’re putting a lot of time and effort to not only provide you with a story-rich game with amazing mechanics on the strategy map and in the battles, but also to make them feel good. Whether it be by improving the timings of the effect to make the impact go “Whoomph”, add visual cues to make it more understandable, or simply make them look better. 

[h3]We love this game, we love the looks and how it plays, and we hope you will too! [/h3]
Thank you for reading, we hope this Dev Diary helped you understand our Technical Artists VFX process more!

Lots of love!
Ilcin & the Chimera Team
